mrds.name: USGS Mineral Resources Data System (MRDS)
mrds.note: Labels = proximity to documented Mn occurrences; USGS coverage of India is partial (a known, disclosed limitation).

gsi_geology_2M.name: Geology of India 1:2M seamless (GSI via Esri India Living Atlas)
gsi_geology_2M.license: GSI via NDSAP — visualization + regional analysis permitted

labels.positive: <= 1.5 km of a USGS MRDS Mn occurrence
labels.caveat: labels = proximity to known mineralization (USGS MRDS), NOT ground-truth ore

methodology.validation: spatial block CV, GroupKFold(5) on 0.1-deg blocks, proximity feature EXCLUDED

honest_auc.scheme: spatial block CV, GroupKFold(5) on 0.1-deg blocks, proximity feature EXCLUDED

methodology.circularity_check: reported side-by-side as an honesty demo (circular CV AUC 1.00 vs honest 0.81/0.88)
methodology.tonnage: estMt = sum(cell prospectivity) x 0.26 Mt x (oreGrade/35) — matches app formula
methodology.cache: region_features.npz stores raw region rasters; re-runs skip all downloads
